source: Runtime route registration and migrated temporary database; no live data

tables.name: alerts
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE alerts (
        id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, external_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, investigation_id TEXT, title TEXT NOT NULL, severity TEXT NOT NULL,
        routing TEXT NOT NULL, disposition TEXT NOT NULL, payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        payload_hash TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, source, external_id),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, rule_id) REFERENCES detection_rules(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT,
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, investigation_id) REFERENCES investigations(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
      )

tables.name: api_sources
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE api_sources (
      id TEXT PRIMARY KEY, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, provider TEXT NOT NULL,
      rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, key_hash TEXT, expires_at TEXT NOT NULL, revoked_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, mapping_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{"fields":{}}',
      FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, rule_id) REFERENCES detection_rules(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
    )

tables.name: artifacts
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE artifacts (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      investigation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      value TEXT NOT NULL,
      label TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      metadata_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
      FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, investigation_id) REFERENCES investigations(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

tables.name: audit_events
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE audit_events (
        id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, resource TEXT NOT NULL, resource_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        action TEXT NOT NULL, details_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
      )

tables.name: case_runbook_events
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE case_runbook_events (
        tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, assignment_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        document_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, assignment_id, version),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, assignment_id) REFERENCES case_runbooks(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )

tables.name: case_runbooks
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE case_runbooks (
        tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, investigation_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        document_json TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, investigation_id, plan_id),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, investigation_id) REFERENCES investigations(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, plan_id) REFERENCES response_plans(tenant_id, id)
      )

tables.name: connectors
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE connectors (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      type TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      workspace_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      client_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      secret_ciphertext TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      config_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'untested',
      last_tested_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
    )

tables.name: detection_rule_versions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE detection_rule_versions (
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, rule_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL, snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, rule_id, version),
      FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, rule_id) REFERENCES detection_rules(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

tables.name: detection_rules
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE detection_rules (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      mitre_techniques_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      execution_mode TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'scheduled',
      enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      severity TEXT NOT NULL,
      detections INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      investigations INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      false_positive_rate REAL NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      recommendation_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_analyzed',
      last_activity_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, query TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', schedule TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Every 5 minutes', lookback_window TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '15 minutes', routing TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Investigate',
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
    )

tables.name: hunts
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE hunts (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      name TEXT NOT NULL,
      query TEXT NOT NULL,
      source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'ad_hoc',
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft',
      verdict TEXT,
      findings_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      last_run_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, insight_refs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
    )

tables.name: investigation_feedback
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE investigation_feedback (
        id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, investigation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        comment TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, investigation_id) REFERENCES investigations(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )

tables.name: investigation_jobs
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE investigation_jobs (
        id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, investigation_id TEXT NOT NULL, alert_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('queued','running','completed','failed')),
        phase INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (phase BETWEEN 0 AND 3),
        error TEXT, result_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, investigation_id) REFERENCES investigations(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, alert_id) REFERENCES alerts(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE RESTRICT
      )

tables.name: investigation_steps
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE investigation_steps (
        id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, investigation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        title TEXT NOT NULL, conclusion TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', tool TEXT NOT NULL,
        request_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', response_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, investigation_id) REFERENCES investigations(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )

tables.name: investigations
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE investigations (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      source TEXT NOT NULL,
      category TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'other',
      severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('low','medium','high','critical')),
      status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('open','investigating','contained','resolved','closed')),
      determination TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (determination IN ('unknown','benign','suspicious','malicious','mitigated')),
      risk_score INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0 CHECK (risk_score BETWEEN 0 AND 100),
      owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AISOC Agent',
      primary_entity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      replay_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL, insight_refs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
    )

tables.name: remediations
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE remediations (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      investigation_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      action_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      connector TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending',
      executed_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
      FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, investigation_id) REFERENCES investigations(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

tables.name: response_plan_versions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE response_plan_versions (
        tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, plan_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
        snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, action TEXT NOT NULL, actor TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, plan_id, version),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, plan_id) REFERENCES response_plans(tenant_id, id)
      )

tables.name: response_plans
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE response_plans (
        tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, id TEXT NOT NULL, document_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
      )

tables.name: schema_migrations
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE schema_migrations (
      version INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
      applied_at TEXT NOT NULL
    )

tables.name: skill_application_feedback
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE skill_application_feedback (
        id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, application_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        rating TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (rating IN ('helpful','not_helpful')),
        comment TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, application_id, created_by),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, application_id) REFERENCES skill_applications(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )

tables.name: skill_applications
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE skill_applications (
        id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, skill_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        target_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (target_type IN ('investigation','hunt')), target_id TEXT NOT NULL,
        skill_version INTEGER NOT NULL, reason TEXT NOT NULL, snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
        FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, skill_id) REFERENCES skills(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
      )

tables.name: skill_material_versions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE skill_material_versions (
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, material_id TEXT NOT NULL, version INTEGER NOT NULL,
      snapshot_json TEXT NOT NULL, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, material_id, version),
      FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, material_id) REFERENCES skill_materials(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

tables.name: skill_materials
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE skill_materials (
      id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, skill_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
      kind TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (kind IN ('reference','checklist','example')),
      file_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (file_type IN ('markdown','text','json','csv','url')),
      source_url TEXT, content TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      archived_at TEXT, created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, skill_id) REFERENCES skills(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

tables.name: skill_suggestions
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE skill_suggestions (
        id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, signature TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL,
        explanation TEXT NOT NULL, source TEXT NOT NULL, category TEXT NOT NULL,
        case_count INTEGER NOT NULL, feedback_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
        sample_case_ids_json TEXT NOT NULL, draft_json TEXT NOT NULL,
        status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending' CHECK (status IN ('pending','accepted','dismissed')),
        accepted_skill_id TEXT, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
        PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), UNIQUE (tenant_id, signature)
      )

tables.name: skills
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE skills (
      id TEXT NOT NULL, tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL, name TEXT NOT NULL, skill_type TEXT NOT NULL,
      description TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', apply_when TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '', content_markdown TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      modules_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', connectors_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', alert_types_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      alert_categories_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', source_entities_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', runtime_entities_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      insight_refs_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]', origin TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'user',
      state TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'draft', enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
      created_by TEXT NOT NULL, created_at TEXT NOT NULL, updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id), CHECK (skill_type IN ('strategy','content')), CHECK (state IN ('draft','published')), CHECK (enabled IN (0,1))
    )

tables.name: threat_indicators
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE threat_indicators (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      report_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      indicator_type TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (indicator_type IN ('ip','domain','hash_sha256','hash_md5','url','email','cve')),
      value TEXT NOT NULL,
      severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'medium',
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK (status IN ('active','mitigated','expired','false_positive')),
      hits INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      last_seen_at TEXT,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id),
      FOREIGN KEY (tenant_id, report_id) REFERENCES threat_intel_reports(tenant_id, id) ON DELETE CASCADE
    )

tables.name: threat_intel_reports
tables.sql:
CREATE TABLE threat_intel_reports (
      id TEXT NOT NULL,
      tenant_id TEXT NOT NULL,
      title TEXT NOT NULL,
      summary TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
      source TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'AISOC',
      report_type TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'threat_report' CHECK (report_type IN ('threat_report','advisory','ioc_feed','hunt_pack')),
      severity TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (severity IN ('low','medium','high','critical')),
      status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'new' CHECK (status IN ('new','reviewing','actionable','archived')),
      ioc_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      hunt_status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'not_started' CHECK (hunt_status IN ('not_started','hunting','completed','no_findings')),
      hunts_launched INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      findings_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
      tags_json TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '[]',
      published_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      created_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,
      PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, id)
    )
